title: "Set up your computer"
extensions:
  atelier:
    duration: 10 min
---

This module prepares your computer.
You install Quarto, then you make sure that it works.

## Goals

::: {.objectives}

- Install Quarto.
- Read the version of Quarto in a terminal.

:::

## Check your set-up

Open a terminal and read the version of Quarto.
The command prints one line.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto --version
1.11.9
```

If the terminal prints a version number, Quarto is ready.
If it prints an error, go to the next page and install the tools.

## Next step

The next page lists the tools and how to install them.
